title: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of the Synbiotic Dual Cap® on Gastrointestinal Comfort in Adults Initiating GLP-1 or Dual-Incretin Therapy for Weight Loss.
official: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of the Synbiotic Dual Cap® on Gastrointestinal Comfort in Adults Initiating GLP-1 or Dual-Incretin Therapy for Weight Loss.
summary:
This is a decentralized, single-group, open-label clinical trial evaluating the effects of the Synbiotic Dual Cap® in 40 adults who have initiated GLP-1 or dual-incretin therapy within the preceding 60 days and who are experiencing at least one associated gastrointestinal symptom. All participants will receive the Synbiotic Dual Cap® (1 capsule daily, taken in the morning without food) alongside their existing GLP-1 medication for 12 consecutive weeks.

Participants will complete study-specific questionnaires at four assessment timepoints: Baseline, Week 4, Week 8, and Week 12. No placebo control arm is included; all efficacy comparisons are within-subject against Baseline values. The study is conducted entirely remotely via the Citruslabs digital platform, with the study product shipped directly to participants' homes.
conditions: GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Therapy-Associated Gastrointestinal Symptoms
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged 18-65 years.
* Have initiated a GLP-1 receptor agonist or dual-incretin medication for weight loss (including but not limited to semaglutide, tirzepatide, or liraglutide) within the last 60 days prior to the date of enrollment.
* Self-reported experience of at least one gastrointestinal symptom associated with GLP-1 initiation, including nausea, bloating, constipation, diarrhea, or general digestive discomfort, at the time of screening.
* Currently on a stable GLP-1 dose as directed by their prescribing physician.
* Willing to take one Synbiotic Dual Cap® daily for 12 consecutive weeks alongside their existing GLP-1 medication and complete all questionnaire assessments at Baseline, Week 4, Week 8, and Week 12.
* Willing and able to provide informed consent prior to enrollment.
* In good general health (GLP-1 use and associated weight-related conditions do not disqualify a participant).
* Reside in the United States.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently pregnant or breastfeeding (or planning to become pregnant during the study period).
* Currently taking other fibre, probiotic, prebiotic, or synbiotic supplements that cannot be discontinued for the study period.
* Diagnosed with a chronic gastrointestinal condition requiring active prescription medical management - including Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, coeliac disease, GERD, or gastroparesis - that would independently confound GI symptom endpoints.
* Use of antibiotics or prescription gastrointestinal medications within the past 30 days prior to enrollment, or intentions to use these medications during the study period.
* Anyone currently participating or planning to participate in another research study during the study period.
* Currently receiving immunosuppressant therapy of any kind.
* Currently undergoing cancer treatment or have had a serious illness requiring hospitalization in the last three months.
* Reside in Hawaii.
* Known allergy or hypersensitivity to any ingredient in the Synbiotic Dual Cap®.
